## Progress

- [PR #1440](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/1440): note template "dental" v1; the clinic default templates (Settings › Dental), so a dental clinic's notes start on it; lidocaine and articaine with adrenaline, chlorhexidine, metronidazole, clindamycin and diclofenac on the shared starter list with their classes
- Needs a person (AC3): a dentist approves the template and the medicine list; a regulatory adviser confirms each class

## Description

A dental template in the P2-025 engine (chief complaint, extra-oral and intra-oral examination, findings from the tooth chart, plan, advice) and dental items in the formulary (local anaesthetics such as lignocaine with adrenaline, chlorhexidine mouthwash, common dental analgesics and antibiotics).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The owner can pick the dental template as the clinic default.
- [ ] **AC2.** Dental medicines are searchable and carry their regulatory class.
- [ ] **AC3.** A dentist approves the template and the medicine list.

## Notes / open questions

- Source: DentalERP (github.com/abinauv/dental-erp, MIT; reference reviewed 17 Nov 2026).
- Data to take: prisma/seed-data/IN/medications.ts, 8 dental medicines (amoxicillin, ibuprofen, paracetamol, metronidazole, chlorhexidine mouthwash, diclofenac, omeprazole, clindamycin) with default dose, frequency and duration. No local anaesthetic in any seed set: lignocaine with adrenaline is new. Each item still needs its Schedule class (ADR-015).
- Template fields to read: components/treatments/treatment-editor.tsx (chief complaint, findings, diagnosis, procedure notes, materials used).
